_note: KY-002 vibration/shock switch module. 3-pin: SIG (digital output, LOW when vibration detected — ball switch with pull-up), VCC, GND. Functionally identical to a tilt switch on a carrier board. The underlying ball-switch behavior is modeled by the tilt_sensor engine (2-terminal passive a/b); this sidecar represents the KY-002 module form factor with its on-board pull-up resistor.
